الـmyoglobin وسلاسل الـhemoglobin لهم نف: Myoglobin and the hemoglobin chains share the same globular fold, i.e. a similar tertiary structure, but their amino acid sequence (primary structure) differs. Myoglobin is a single chain, so it has no quaternary structure. So a is correct, and the printed b says the tertiary structure differs, which is the opposite of the truth.
الـnucleotide يتكوّن من قاعدة نيتروجينية: A nucleotide is made of a nitrogenous base + a five-carbon sugar (pentose) + phosphate, as in Dr. Hesham's book. A base + sugar is a nucleoside (option b).
الـS-adenosyl methionine (SAM) هو الـact: S-adenosyl methionine (SAM) is the active methionine and the main donor of the methyl group in biological reactions, as in Dr. Hesham's book. FAD and NAD are electron carriers, not methyl donors.
الـuridine هو قاعدة اليوراسيل (pyrimidin: Uridine is the base uracil (a pyrimidine) attached to ribose, i.e. a nucleoside. If a phosphate is added to it, it becomes a nucleotide, UMP.
الـnucleoside (قاعدة + pentose) يتحوّل إ: A nucleoside (base + pentose) becomes a nucleotide by adding a phosphate, as in Dr. Hesham's book. The pentose is already in it.
الـGMP (guanosine monophosphate) هو nucl: GMP (guanosine monophosphate) is a nucleotide: guanine base + ribose + one phosphate, and it is listed among the nucleotides in Dr. Hesham's book. The base alone is guanine, and the nucleoside is guanosine.
نص الاختيار a مقطوع في الملف الأصلي (بين: The text of option a is cut off in the original file (it ends at "the brachialis and" without the rest, and the floor of the cubital fossa is known to be the brachialis and the supinator). Options b, c and d are all anatomically correct, so as written the question has more than one correct answer. It was suspended from scoring and exams until we bring it back with its correct text. الـHb C سببه استبدال الـglutamic acid في: Hb C is caused by substituting glutamic acid at position 6 of the β chain with lysine (option c). The substitution with valine is Hb S (sickle cell anemia), which is what the printed d describes.
الـHbA1c هيموجلوبين ارتبط به جلوكوز تساه: HbA1c is hemoglobin that glucose has bound to covalently and non-enzymatically (option c), it reflects the average glucose over the last 2–3 months, not weeks, and it's present in a small percentage in healthy people. The printed d is wrong.
الـproximal histidine هو His F8 (المرتبط: The proximal histidine is His F8 (directly bound to the iron atom in the heme), and the distal histidine is His E7. The printed b (F6) is wrong.
الـHbF يتكوّن من سلسلتين α وسلسلتين γ (α: HbF is made of two α and two γ chains (α2γ2), so option c is correct; it appears in fetal life, not after birth (d is wrong), and its affinity for oxygen is higher, not lower (b is wrong). Option a (slower than HbA in electrophoresis) is also correct according to the information in Q3 of the same chapter, so both are accepted until the doctor reviews the question.
الإنزيم بيتعرّف على الـsubstrate (المادة: The enzyme recognizes the substrate (the reacting material) and reacts with it (option c). A cofactor is a helper of the enzyme, not what it recognizes, and the printed a is wrong.
الـcaspases إنزيمات بروتيازية من نوع الـ: Caspases are protease enzymes of the cysteine protease type (cysteine in their active site, and they cut after aspartate). Option b is written "Cystine" and what's meant is cysteine. The printed c (Aspartate proteases) is wrong.
الـDNA polymerase ε هو المسؤول عن بناء ا: DNA polymerase ε is responsible for building the leading strand in eukaryotes according to the reference, while δ is for the lagging strand. The printed b (δ) is wrong.
الـtelomerase إنزيم reverse transcriptas: Telomerase is a reverse transcriptase enzyme (it carries an RNA template inside it) and it lengthens chromosome ends, not shortens them. The printed d is wrong.
التسلسل المكمّل المضاد في الاتجاه (antip: The antiparallel complementary sequence of 5'TGGCAGCCT3' is written 5'→3' like this: 5'AGG CTG CCA3' (option c). Option a is the complement without reversing the direction.
الـcholesteryl esters بتتصنّف ضمن الـwax: Cholesteryl esters are classified among the waxes, which is consistent with Q45 in the same chapter (wax = cholesteryl esters), so the answer is a. The printed d (derived lipids) refers to breakdown products such as cholesterol itself. The question is under review with the doctor.
الـpyrimidine nucleotide المذكور في مراج: The pyrimidine nucleotide mentioned in the department's references as a high-energy intermediate (activated precursor) is UDP-glucose, and the references don't describe UTP that way. The printed b is UTP. The question is under review with the doctor.
سبب ثبات الـdouble helix الأساسي هو الـb: The main reason for the stability of the double helix is base stacking (van der Waals forces and hydrophobic interactions between stacked bases), while hydrogen bonds give the specificity of base pairing. The printed d (hydrogen bonds). The question is under review with the doctor.
محتويات الـmid-palmar space: أوتار الـfl: Contents of the mid-palmar space: the long flexor tendons of fingers 3, 4 and 5 + the lumbricals (2, 3 and 4) + the vessels and nerves of the fingers. The ulnar synovial bursa is not among its contents. The printed b is wrong.
الـlumbricals بتنشأ من أوتار الـflexor d: The lumbricals arise from the tendons of flexor digitorum profundus (not superficialis), they flex the MCP and extend the IP, and only two of them (the medial ones) are supplied by the ulnar nerve, not all by the median. The printed a is wrong.
الـsecondary (definitive) yolk sac بيتكو: The secondary (definitive) yolk sac forms on day 13 of pregnancy, i.e. in the second week, when new cells from the hypoblast line the primary yolk sac and part of it is pinched off (department book ISK 101 p. 109). In week 4 the yolk sac is compressed by folding and becomes the vitelline duct; that is not the time of its formation. The printed c is wrong.
الـmedian nerve بيعدّي بين راسَي الـpron: The median nerve passes between the two heads of pronator teres (not the FDS), and then goes down under flexor digitorum superficialis, between it and the profundus (department book ISK 101 pp. 209–210), so option d (the printed one) is not correct. Option c is the right one in the general references: the FDS belly for the index finger separates early in the forearm, and this gives the index finger independent movement. The question is under review with the doctor.
الجدار الجانبي (Humeral) للإبط: الأخدود: The lateral (humeral) wall of the axilla: the bicipital groove of the humerus + the short head of biceps + the coracobrachialis. The subclavius is from the anterior wall, and the long head of biceps doesn't take part.
الثنية الأمامية للإبط (Anterior axillary: The anterior axillary fold = the lower border of pectoralis major, and pectoralis minor is deeper than it.
الجدار الخلفي (Subscapular): الـsubscapu: The posterior (subscapular) wall: subscapularis (lateral part) + teres major + latissimus dorsi.
محتويات الإبط: الشريان والوريد الإبطي، ح: Contents of the axilla: the axillary artery and vein, the cords of the brachial plexus and their branches, lymph nodes, fat, and the tail of the breast. The trunks lie in the neck above the clavicle.
الجدار الأمامي: pectoralis major + (subc: The anterior wall: pectoralis major + (subclavius, clavipectoral fascia and pectoralis minor). Teres major is from the posterior wall.
الـclavipectoral fascia بتغلّف الـpector: The clavipectoral fascia encloses pectoralis minor, and the fascia that covers it continues downward as the suspensory ligament of the axillary fascia (the floor of the axilla).
الألياف الوسطى للـdeltoid بتبعّد الذراع: The middle fibers of deltoid abduct the arm from 15 to 90 degrees, and its nerve is the axillary (circumflex) nerve (C5, 6).
الفراغ المثلثي العلوي (Upper triangular: The upper triangular space: above by teres minor (behind) and subscapularis (in front), below by teres major, and laterally by the long head of triceps, and only the circumflex scapular artery passes through it. The axillary nerve passes through the quadrangular space.
المفتاح ده (c) مطابق للإجابة النموذجية ل: This key (c) matches Dr. Ahmed Galal's model answer: his written text is "Pectoralis major and minor share in the formation of its anterior wall", which is option c on the site (his table has the letter A, but the text next to it matches c), and the department book (ISK 101 · p. 169 table 4.1) confirms it.
الجدار الأمامي فيه الـpectoralis major (: The anterior wall has pectoralis major (a superficial layer) and pectoralis minor (within the deep axillary septum). The posterior: subscapularis, teres major and latissimus dorsi (not teres minor), and the narrowest is the lateral, not the medial.
نص الكتاب بيسمّي قمة الإبط «cervico-axil: The book's text calls the apex of the axilla the "cervico-axillary canal", and its boundaries are in figure 4.1 (not written in the text). The key here is by elimination from the book's text: the axillary artery begins at the outer border of the first rib (so option a is wrong), the roots are in the neck and the divisions only at the apex of the axilla (so option c is wrong), and what passes through the canal are the axillary vessels (so option d is wrong). It's known in anatomy that its posterior boundary is the upper border of the scapula (b), and Dr. Ahmed Galal confirmed (b) in the model answer.
الـaxillary septum (الطبقة العميقة من ال: The axillary septum (the deep layer of the anterior wall) = subclavius + clavipectoral fascia + pectoralis minor + the suspensory ligament. The axillary sheath is not part of it.
الجدار الإنسي (Costal): الأضلاع الأربعة: The medial (costal) wall: the upper four ribs with their intercostal muscles + the upper part of serratus anterior.
الـsubscapularis من الجدار الخلفي للإبط،: Subscapularis is from the posterior wall of the axilla, not the anterior.
الـroots بتقع في الرقبة، ومحتويات الإبط: The roots lie in the neck, and the contents of the axilla include only the cords. The other statements are right: the posterior wall (subscapularis, teres major and latissimus dorsi), the connection with the neck through the cervico-axillary canal, and serratus anterior in the medial wall.
الـtrunks في الرقبة فوق الترقوة والـdivi: The trunks are in the neck above the clavicle and the divisions are at the apex of the axilla behind the clavicle, while what's inside the axilla are the cords and their branches (including the axillary nerve).
الإبط بيتصل بالرقبة عن طريق الـcervico-a: The axilla connects to the neck through the cervico-axillary canal (its apex). Pectoralis major and minor are in the anterior wall, not the medial, and the posterior isn't subscapularis alone, and the roots are in the neck.
